name: IEUM cumulative context adapter proposal

boundary.input: Locally admitted normalized analysis/call/SMS/mail events; synthetic fixture adapter only for this handoff.
boundary.output: Candidate context delta plus provenance and holds. Canonical projection writes require existing native authorization and fresh fences.
reuse_first: Existing phone normalizer and exclusion checks
forbidden: Wire expansion of frozen model six fields
A mock review flag used as production authorization

adapter_contract.notes: Logical local DTO proposal only. Source inspection must map these concepts to existing classes; these names are not a new production API.
adapter_contract.trust_context: A separate repository-issued handle binding owner, source/version/hash, relationRevision, userRevision, lockRevision, taskRevision, boardRevision, archiveRevision and leaseEpoch. Adapter/model fields cannot issue this handle.

identity.phone: Reuse existing KR validator with raw input, country/profile, normalizer version and reason. Canonical endpoint is a contact route, not person ID. Shared numbers/time-bounded ownership remain separate.
identity.email: Retain local-part semantics; do not strip +tags/dots or assume provider aliases. A domain/name/CC/forwarded address alone proves neither person nor work. Preserve raw form.
identity.evidence: Use reviewed direct self-identification, explicit work/contact statement, or reviewed continuous reply context. Store identity and work evidence separately with original source/version/quote. Derived summaries do not count as independent evidence.
identity.ambiguous: Retain candidate and original source in an unresolved queue. Do not update any person's current summary or work/document/task projection on ambiguity.
identity.owner_scope: Every lookup, dedup key, candidate, receipt, evidence relation and projection stays within owner. No hash or phone cross-owner merge.

ordering_and_idempotency.dedup: Exact same (owner/channel/namespace/externalId/sourceVersion) and same hash returns the previous receipt after fresh current fences. Same key/version with different hash is quarantined. The hash alone is never event identity.
ordering_and_idempotency.revision: sourceVersion orders mutations of one source only. Keep revisions, observed sequence, task/user/board revisions and receipt head separate.
ordering_and_idempotency.late: Newer observation time does not make older occurredAt current. Preserve timeline evidence and recompute affected projection from active source heads.
ordering_and_idempotency.causal: Explicit valid supersedes/reply links can establish scoped precedence. An unknown effective time or equal-time contradictory facts without a causal link remain held; deterministic display ordering is not semantic precedence.
ordering_and_idempotency.correction: A new revision supersedes claims of its previous revision atomically. Do not append both to current state. Retain provenance/history according to retention policy.
ordering_and_idempotency.cancellation: A source tombstone invalidates that source's current derived evidence; a business cancellation is a claim requiring its own review/gate. Neither completes a task. Missing targets remain pending; late lower revisions cannot resurrect a tombstoned source.
ordering_and_idempotency.equal_hash: Two channels/ids with identical bytes are two source records. Evidence from quoted copies may share an origin evidence key and count once, without deleting either source.

application.transaction: Use existing repository transaction after final owner/source/version/hash/lease + manual/lock/task/board/relation/archive checks; save candidate, history, receipt, current-head and permitted projection atomically. Do not retrofit INSERT OR REPLACE over immutable receipts.
application.canonical_gate: Default proposal-only; proposed claims update canonical state only through the existing allowed native application path. Static fixtures' authorization markers are synthetic, not a new grant.
application.manual_done: Manual DONE is sticky. A later request/reopen proposal cannot reset DONE, due date or assignee. Explicit user reopen requires its own action and current CAS.
application.conflict: Keep conflict candidate and untouched user values when user/task/lock/board/relation revisions changed. Source/owner/lease invalidation is a different rejected/held path.
application.partial: If protection can be checked per disjoint field, apply only the authorized nonconflicting scope. Otherwise hold the whole atomic batch; never claim partial success without exact receipts.
application.archive: Hidden and conflict are independent. New results do not restore an archived item or expose its body.
application.source_loss: Invalidate derived relation/current caches; preserve manual fields and lawful audit references. Do not duplicate deleted original text as history.

integration_patch.reason: No verified source tree or existing APIs available; a speculative migration would duplicate/overwrite unknown existing features.
